name: Split a plugin into free (WordPress.org) and pro
query: We want a free version on WordPress.org and a paid pro add-on. How should we structure it?
expected_behavior: Step 1: Load references/commercial-distribution.md (free version section) and wp-plugin-directory-guidelines
Step 2: Keep the free plugin fully functional with no license checks or locked features
Step 3: Make pro a separate plugin with Requires Plugins: <free-slug> and its own Update URI
Step 4: Limit upsells to the plugin's own screens and make them dismissible
success_criteria: No trialware in the free plugin
Pro does not hijack the free plugin's WordPress.org updates
